fields.features_heading: What Goes Into a Waxing Consent Form
fields.features_subheading: Each section covers something your esthetician would otherwise ask at the table, and each signed form stays on file by client.
fields.feature_1:
Skin questions asked before the first strip

Ask about retinoid creams, acne medication, recent sunburn, and any peel or laser work since the last visit. Each answer is its own field, and the esthetician reads every yes first.
fields.feature_2:
Consent statements the client initials

Write what the client agrees to in plain sentences: they answered honestly, results vary from person to person, and they will follow your aftercare sheet. Each line gets initials.
fields.feature_3:
A signature from any phone or tablet

Clients sign with a finger on their own phone or on the tablet at the front desk. The app captures the e-signature and saves it on the record beside the answers it confirms.
fields.feature_4:
Aftercare sent with the signed copy

Email each client a copy of the form they signed, with your aftercare sheet attached, the moment they tap submit. The client keeps both in their inbox for the days after the wax.
fields.feature_5:
Every visit in one client history

Each signed form is a row in a database you own, holding the client, the areas waxed, and the visit date. Type a name at the front desk to see every wax and every answer on file.
fields.feature_6:
Code your developer can take over

Export the full source to your GitHub repository on paid plans when the form belongs inside your booking site. A developer can host it anywhere and keep building on it from there.

fields.usecase_heading: How Salons Use a Waxing Consent Form
fields.tab_content_1:
Only the areas Tessa booked, each with its questions

Tessa Moreau books her first Brazilian and an underarm wax at Saltwater Wax Co. Her form asks the questions for those 2 areas and nothing about her face or legs. She answers yes to a recent sunburn, and esthetician Nina Caldwell gets an email the day before with that answer at the top.
fields.tab_content_2:
With a patch test on file, the tint section opens

Hollis Brow Bar tints only after a patch test taken at least 48 hours ahead. Leah Brandt books a brow wax and tint for Saturday, and her Wednesday patch test is already on her record. Her form opens the tint section. A client with no patch test on file sees the wax section only, plus a link to book a test.
fields.tab_content_3:
For a client of 15, a parent signs as well

Orchard Lane Salon asks for date of birth first, and its policy is a parent signature for any client under 18. Josie Hart is 15, and her eyebrow waxing consent form opens a parent section after the birth date. Ellen Hart signs as her mother on the same record as Josie.
fields.tab_content_4:
Members re-sign once a year from an emailed link

Bluebird Wax Club has 212 members, and each one re-signs the consent once a year. When a signature has 30 days left, the app emails that member a renewal link. Nine members are due this month, Ivy Sato among them, and her new signature lands on her record beside last year's.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Waxing Consent Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps from a list of the areas you wax to a tested waxing consent form your clients sign before the appointment.
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Decide when the link goes out
fields.howto_step_1_des: List every area you wax, such as brows, lip, underarm, legs, and Brazilian, and mark the ones you also tint. Each area becomes a choice at the top of the form, and the questions a client sees depend on the areas picked.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Copy the questions from your current paper form, then ask each esthetician what they still end up asking at the table. Add those too, and give every question a yes or no answer plus a box for details.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Have a local attorney read your consent and any release wording before the form goes live. Keep that wording in one place, and note the date whenever it changes, so you know which version each client signed.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Send the link with the booking confirmation for first visits, and keep a tablet at the front desk for walk-ins. Decide how often regulars re-sign, at every visit or once a year, and set the reminder email to match.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste your questions and consent wording into a prompt and name the areas you wax. Emergent builds the form and the database behind it from that prompt. Ask for changes in plain English, such as a Spanish version or a new tint section.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Connect it to your booking tool
fields.howto_step_6_des: Link each signed record to its appointment in the booking software you already use, since Emergent connects to any tool with an API. Have the app email the esthetician on the booking about any yes answer before the client arrives.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test it as two different clients
fields.howto_step_7_des: Fill the form twice yourself, once as a 16-year-old booking a brow wax and once as an adult booking a Brazilian. Check that the parent section and the right area questions appear, then open both records as your front desk would.

faq_plan.q: What is a waxing consent form?
faq_plan.a: A waxing consent form is the record a client completes and signs before a wax. It lists the areas being waxed and the client's answers to the salon's skin and medication questions. It also carries the client's agreement to the service and to the salon's aftercare instructions.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a waxing consent form?
faq_plan.a: List the areas you wax and the questions your estheticians ask, then describe the form in plain English to Emergent's AI form builder. Emergent builds the form and its database from that prompt. To reword a question or add a section later, prompt again.

faq_plan.q: Is a waiver the same as a wax consent form?
faq_plan.a: They can be one document. Whatever you call it, the form needs the areas booked and the client's answers next to the consent itself. If your attorney suggests release wording, give it its own section of the wax consent form with a separate initials box. The waiver part is then easy to find.

faq_plan.q: What should body waxing consent forms ask before a leg or back wax?
faq_plan.a: Ask which body areas are booked, when the client last shaved each one, and whether the skin there has a sunburn, a rash, or a fresh tattoo. Keep other services on their own forms. A permanent makeup consent form, for one, asks about pigments and earlier work that body waxing consent forms never need.

faq_plan.q: What goes on a Brazilian wax consent form?
faq_plan.a: It holds your standard waxing questions plus a few for the bikini area. Ask whether this is the client's first Brazilian and how much hair they want left, and note any piercings nearby. The Brazilian wax consent form that Emergent builds saves each signed copy to a database you own.

faq_plan.q: Can one brow wax and tint consent form cover both services?
faq_plan.ref: brow wax and tint consent form
faq_plan.secondary: brow wax and tint consent form
faq_plan.a: Yes. Give the wax and the tint their own sections and signature lines, and a client who skips the tint that day signs only for the wax. One brow wax and tint consent form then keeps both services and both signatures on a single client record.

faq_plan.q: Does an eyebrow wax and tint consent form need a patch test question?
faq_plan.ref: eyebrow wax and tint consent form
faq_plan.secondary: eyebrow wax and tint consent form
faq_plan.a: Yes, if your salon patch tests before tinting. Ask for the test date and the result, and record the tint shade beside them, much as a tattoo consent form records the design next to the signature. An eyebrow wax and tint consent form with those fields shows the esthetician everything before the brush comes out.

faq_plan.q: What should a facial waxing consent form ask about skin care products?
faq_plan.a: Ask by product type, not brand name, and ask when the client last used each one. A facial waxing consent form that records a date beside each yes gives the esthetician what they need to decide at the table. Add a line for anything new the client started since the last visit.

faq_plan.q: Can I make a free waxing consent form online?
faq_plan.a: Yes, you can build a free waxing consent form with Emergent and share its link with clients. Emergent is free to start, and the free tier covers building and publishing. The form has no response caps, however many clients sign it.

faq_plan.q: Should clients sign a new waxing consent form at every visit?
faq_plan.a: Not always. Have regulars confirm their answers at each visit, and ask for a new signed consent form whenever an answer changes or your wording does. Keep every signed version on the client's record instead of replacing the last one. The record then shows what they agreed to on any date.
